name: Rajagiri Hospital
summary: Rajagiri Hospital is a multispecialty hospital at Chunangamvely, Aluva, established in 2014 on a 40-acre campus near Cochin International Airport. It is accredited by Joint Commission International and NABH, and runs a 24-hour international patient helpdesk.
highlights: Accredited by Joint Commission International (JCI) with the Gold Seal, and by NABH
24-hour international patient helpdesk with language interpretation
Centres in gastrointestinal sciences, oncology and haemato-oncology, cardiology, neurology, and movement disorders
Set on a 40-acre campus close to Cochin International Airport
